new_public_evidence.source: Dau and Chopin, Waste-Free Sequential Monte Carlo, JRSS B 84(1), 2022
new_public_evidence.result: Proposition 2 states that the product of average potentials is an unbiased normalising-constant estimate; the proof reduces to the standard SMC unbiasedness result.

new_public_evidence.source: Douc, Cappé, Moulines, Comparison of Resampling Schemes for Particle Filtering, 2005
new_public_evidence.result: Independent stratified resampling is defined for n offspring from m weighted parents and satisfies the target weighted empirical expectation property for integrable test functions; it also has conditional variance no larger than multinomial.

new_public_evidence.source: Zhou, Johansen, Aston, Toward Automatic Model Comparison: An Adaptive Sequential Monte Carlo Approach
new_public_evidence.result: The paper explicitly warns that the standard normalising-constant estimate need not be unbiased under generic adaptive techniques. This prevents overgeneralising the predictable-N lemma to adaptive target schedules/current-step peeking.

derived_results.claim: For a bootstrap/Feynman-Kac PF, if N_t and generation-t tuning are chosen from F_{t-1}, stratified resampling is conditionally unbiased, and the generation-t kernel/potential are fixed before generation-t randomness, then the usual unnormalised particle measure remains exactly unbiased by induction even when N_t varies; hence E[Zhat_t]=Z_t.

If a completed pilot unbiased Z estimate selects a fresh production configuration and every selected fixed configuration has conditional mean Z, then a prespecified convex combination of pilot and production Z estimates is unbiased. The pilot-production covariance vanishes because the production error has conditional mean zero given the pilot.

In a fresh 2,500-replicate-per-position 12-generation two-state Feynman-Kac stress with total cost 768, the 192/576 reusable pilot design using generation-local potential CV^2 had mean MSE ratio 1.02799 versus full uniform, range 0.77964 to 1.17010; discarding the pilot averaged 1.34059. Thus reuse removes most pilot-cost damage but the local-CV2 allocation is not a robust improvement.

engineering_update.scope: Exact derived unbiasedness lemmas under predictable choices plus a synthetic two-state independent-stratified PF stress. MSE dominance is not claimed.

negative_or_scope_evidence: Generic adaptive SMC can bias a standard normalising-constant estimate; the derived lemma applies only when the relevant configuration is predictable before the generation it governs and the target/increment is not data-adapted using that same generation.
Generation-local raw-potential CV^2 correctly localises the shock but is too myopic to allocate particles robustly; ancestry and future continuation affect downstream variance.
The fresh stress had average reusable-pilot MSE about 2.8% above full uniform and a worst discrete shock about 17% above, so previous single-toy reuse gains do not establish robust superiority.
A pilot-dependent final blend weight can bias the aggregate; fixed/cost-prespecified weights remain the safe default.
No real-agent or AGI performance claim follows from this synthetic PF model.
